quarterly_data.quarter: SCREEN Holdings semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 274,299 million (-1.1% YoY); operating income JPY 46,454 million (-20.2%) on higher fixed costs and lower sales; ordinary income JPY 46,844 million (-20.1%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 31,855 million (-18.0%). SPE sales JPY 218,597 million (-4.6%): memory sales rose while logic, power semiconductor and foundry sales fell; by region Taiwan rose while China and the US fell; SPE operating income JPY 48,651 million (-17.6%). FT sales JPY 23,556 million (+61.4%) on higher equipment sales, operating income JPY 3,974 million; GA JPY 25,809 million (+2.3%); PE JPY 5,553 million (-20.3%) with an operating loss of JPY 227 million. H1 R&D expense JPY 17,633 million. Management states that the importance of energy-efficient high-speed chip development - finer geometries and advanced packaging including chiplets, supporting wider generative-AI use and DX - is rising and semiconductor investment is expected to accelerate again, and that display demand has entered a recovery phase with panel makers' appetite for capex recovering.
